faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the tournament
faq.stillHaveDesc: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please contact our support team.
faq.a1: The registration fee is NPR 8,000 per team. This includes participation in all matches, player IDs, and access to venue facilities. Payment can be made via eSewa or bank transfer.
faq.q2: How many players can be registered?
faq.a2: Each team must register exactly 10 players. This includes 6 starting players and 4 substitutes. All players must be registered before the deadline.
faq.a3: Registration opens on Bhadra 02, 2083, and closes on Ashoj 27, 2083. The tournament will be held from Ashoj 28 - Ashoj 31, 2083. The match schedule will be published on Ashoj 28, 2083.
faq.a4: The tournament follows a double elimination format. Teams are divided into groups for the initial rounds, followed by knockout stages. The top 3 teams receive prizes.
faq.a5: Yes, all players must be between 16 and 50 years old. Valid identification age (citizenship or passport) must be provided during registration.
faq.q6: Does the organizer provide accommodation, transportation, or food?
faq.a6: No. Teams and players are responsible for arranging their own accommodation, transportation/transportation costs, and meals during the tournament. These services are not provided by the organizer and are not included in the registration fee.
faq.q7: How can I contact the organizers?
faq.a7: You can reach us via phone at 9803977546, email at nayabastisports.official@gmail.com, or visit our office in Kathmandu. Working hours are 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday.
